patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Campaign Monitor and Customer.io share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Comparison thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose Campaign Monitor only if your buying job matches “Design-led email marketing by Marigold with contact-tier Lite, Essentials, Premier, and En” rather than Customer.io's shape. Choose Customer.io only if your buying job matches “Product-led event-driven messaging across email, push, SMS, and in-app — MAP-adjacent to c” rather than Campaign Monitor's shape. Workflow advantage: Campaign Monitor leans small-business-campaigns; Customer.io leans ecommerce-email. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Campaign Monitor and Customer.io share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Campaign Monitor is Design-led email marketing by Marigold with contact-tier Lite, Essentials, Premier, and Enterprise.; Customer.io is Product-led event-driven messaging across email, push, SMS, and in-app — MAP-adjacent to classic ESPs..
- Company-size focus: Campaign Monitor (small-business, mid-market) vs Customer.io (small-business, mid-market, enterprise).
- Workflow coverage skew: Campaign Monitor-leaning small-business-campaigns vs Customer.io-leaning ecommerce-email.
- Researched limits: Campaign Monitor — No forever free plan — trial only; Customer.io — Essentials from $100/mo — not an SMB freemium ESP.

Limitations — Campaign Monitor: No forever free plan — trial only; Lite monthly send caps force upgrades for frequent senders; Customer.io: Essentials from $100/mo — not an SMB freemium ESP; Event/profile model requires product data maturity.

Poor-fit cases: Campaign Monitor is a poor fit when that limitation bites: No forever free plan — trial only · Customer.io is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Essentials from $100/mo — not an SMB freemium ESP · Avoid Campaign Monitor if you actually need Customer.io's motion (Product-led event-driven messaging across email, push, SMS, and in-app — MAP-adj)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
